output.finalMessage: Root cause found and fixed: `triage` in `src/agents.ts` — the agent the support chat actually talks to — was defined without a session `store`, unlike `refundAgent`. Without a persistent store, its session state lives only in memory, so it can't be reloaded by session id on the follow-up turn, forcing the customer to restart. Fixed by adding `store` (the existing `FileSessionStore`) to the `triage` agent config, and wrote `answer.json` with the required details.
